options.name: delay
options.description: Seconds to wait before shutdown. Passed as a parameter to the shutdown command. On Linux, macOS and OpenBSD, this is converted to minutes and rounded down. If less than 60, it is set to 0. On Solaris and FreeBSD, this represents seconds.

options.name: msg
options.description: Message to display to users before shutdown.

options.name: search_paths
options.description: Paths to search on the remote machine for the C(shutdown) command. I(Only) these paths are searched for the C(shutdown) command. E(PATH) is ignored in the remote node when searching for the C(shutdown) command.
